svg.aria-label: Rift's three proxy modes, each sent GET /x three times. proxyOnce, also the default when mode is omitted, forwards the first request, records the answer as a new stub in front of the proxy stub, and replays it, so upstream is called once. proxyAlways forwards every request and records behind the proxy, appending each answer to one recorded stub that answers only once the proxy stops matching. proxyTransparent forwards every request and records nothing.
svg.title: Rift's three proxy modes, each sent GET /x three times. proxyOnce, also the default when mode is omitted, forwards the first request, records the answer as a new stub in front of the proxy stub, and replays it, so upstream is called once. proxyAlways forwards every request and records behind the proxy, appending each answer to one recorded stub that answers only once the proxy stops matching. proxyTransparent forwards every request and records nothing.
svg.text: the recording sits in front of the proxy, so it answers the next GET /x
the proxy still matches first: the recording answers once it stops (mb replay)
a plain reverse proxy: the stub list never changes
without predicateGenerators, proxyOnce replays from an internal store instead of a stub
